description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of licence granted to Orient Finance PLC to carry on finance business w.e.f. 16.07.2015
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the cancellation of a finance business license for a specific company (Orient Finance PLC) under the Finance Business Act. It deals with commercial licensing and regulatory compliance for financial institutions, which falls under the Commercial Gazettes category (Type 6) for business and commercial matters.
